environments.restoreStorage: tmpfs; this proves logical restore, not disk durability/crash recovery
limits: Excludes managed auth,storage,Vault contents/keys,cron schedules,net queues,Realtime policies/settings/publications,EdgeFunctions and external OAuth/Vercel settings.
wordpairs_hosting scheduler definition/state is retained but never invoked on restore; pg_cron/pg_net/Vault require separate managed reprovisioning and purpose-secret configuration.
Existing private runtime/provider configuration files are preserved at their original locations; no new secret store/key is created and these files are not copied into public evidence.

Source row fingerprints use one exported read-only REPEATABLE READ snapshot shared with pg_dump. PostgreSQL sequence state is not MVCC; source values must remain stable before/after dump for exact comparison.
This operator-held local ciphertext is not an independently stored off-site backup and existing SSH private identity must be retained to decrypt it.
environments.schemaComparisonScope: Eight projected sections: columns/defaults/types, constraints, indexes, function definition SHA256/security-definer/config, table RLS flags, triggers, policies, and effective relation/function ACL. Namespace ACL/default privileges, standalone view/type/sequence definitions are included by selected-schema pg_dump but are not independently compared by this projection. Object ownership is normalized; global role credentials/membership/settings require separate provisioning.
